title: U.S. Air Force expands Blue Origin rocket cargo contract
summary: The U.S. Air Force Research Laboratory increased Blue Origin's contract by $11.7 million to study space rockets for point-to-point deliveries. This expansion focuses on exploring the potential of rockets for rapid cargo transport.

summary: Converting a Mars rover engineering model into a lunar rover could cost NASA over $1 billion, a claim disputed by the agency's administrator.

title: Spain commits up to $2.3 billion for national military communications for IRIS²
